title: Nice bowls. Pretty bowls.  Well made.  But the pouring design is lacking.
text: Nice bowls. Pretty bowls.  Well made.  But the pouring design is lacking.. This is a pretty set, nice color, well made and very useable as bowls., However, the handle is too awkward to use for lifting and pouring, particularly given the weight of the bowls.  I hefted an empty one and mimicked pouring and it's not convenient.  Unlike a regular handle, it takes two hands to grasp and pour.  If the contents were hot, it would particularly be a problem.  The spout is broad and shallow.  I withhold judgment but as a person who has cooked and baked for over fifty years, I'm expecting it won't pour as precisely as I'd like.  I wanted these to be both pretty and practical.  I don't really need more bowls.  I wanted very effective, easy to manage pouring function.

description: Mix and serve with the performance and style of the Rachael Ray 2-Piece Ceramic Mixing Bowl Set. Crafted of high-quality, durable ceramic and finished with a stain-resistant glaze, these stylish mixing bowls in two sizes will have home cooks prepared to handle comfy oven-to-table recipes, meal after meal. Whip up a batch of Rachael's Cheese Blintz Pancakes or prepare her tasty Dried-Cherry Bourbon Cranberry Sauce in these beautifully glazed bowls with convenient pour spouts to easily pour batters and sauces without creating a mess. Large handles are designed for a comfortable hold when mixing, pouring, and serving, and the bowls are designed to stack neatly inside one another for space-saving storage. These versatile mixing bowls are also microwave, freezer, and dishwasher safe for popping popcorn or freezing leftovers with quick and easy cleanup.
